title: Adopted -ffunction-sections and --gc-sections for apollo-main; image 3,620,044 B (saved 199,404); both paired sims passed; -Oz not needed

changes.profiles: Added -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections to 17 g2-apollo-main-* profiles that lacked them; 26 already had both. Other payloads untouched.

changes.keep: g2-apollo-main.ld already KEEP'd .isr_vector and kvdb_migration, plus the OTA flag and bond-record NOLOAD sections. Added KEEP(*(.itcm_text .itcm_text.*)) and KEEP(*(.ramfunc .ramfunc.*)) so the region-table ramfuncs survive gc.
changes.duplicate_override: Function-sections made the existing strong pair am_hal_sysctrl_aircr_reset visible to the compose duplicate check (self_recovery.c vs generated HAL). Followed the existing #if 0 pattern in sources.json generated[] for ambiqhal-apollo510/am_hal_sysctrl.c so the intentional g2_recovery_reset_app override is the sole definition.

build.compiled: 2718/2718, 0 failures, 0 duplicate strong symbols, 21 composed unresolved (linker-script symbols)

dfu_mismatch.note: The established 8s DFU-mismatch fixture checks that a mismatched controller does not trap post-reset in SBL wired-load; it is not an 8-second completed DFU cycle. Same end state as opencfw-otap-disarm-dfu-mismatch.
